serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I was scared, because she was told about it by someone else. The thought of people knowing about my firing, laughing at me, made me feel insecure...
You: Not so long ago I got an email inviting me for a class meetup.
You: Like I would ever show up there. They would just start talking behind my back as soon as I show up there.
Blaubleim: I’m aware that you had some troubles in school and while I think not going there is a reasonable decision, you need to properly explain this to your mom, not scream at her.
You: I know…
